_about: P-ROUTER-001 v2 few-shot examples (CF-010): 11 of the 30 v1 examples, chosen for the errors measured on the D5 dev set (regime inferred from the class, refusals, multi-intent, photo) + 2 new ones (own data, sending on behalf). Compact outputs = router.schema.json v2. Never copied from T1–T5 or D5 (validator: < 6 shared consecutive words).
